Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class DummyDataService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.DummyDataService
public class DummyDataService extends Object
In-memory data store for the frontend demo.

All data is lost when the application closes. The service deliberately keeps the "business rules" (approval, take-down, soft delete, notification, rating visibility) here rather than in the JavaFX controllers so the same rules are applied no matter which screen triggers them.

TODO: Replace this service with real repositories / API clients.

    • deactivateUser

      public boolean deactivateUser(String username, String actor)
      Deactivates an account. The user cannot log in and their live listings disappear from the marketplace (they are retained and reappear on reactivation).

    • reactivateUser

      public boolean reactivateUser(String username, String actor)
      Reactivates a previously deactivated account.

    • deleteUser

      public boolean deleteUser(String username, String actor)
      Soft-deletes an account.

      The account is marked deleted and inactive, hidden from every user list, and can no longer log in. The user's listings are set to REMOVED and disappear from the marketplace, while deals, chats and ratings are retained so history and the audit trail stay intact. Active deals involving the account are cancelled and the counterparties are notified.
